# Breadcrumb

Shows the location in a hierarchy (nav aria-label=breadcrumb). The current page is BreadcrumbPage with aria-current=page; long trails collapse into an ellipsis menu.

## Import

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbEllipsis, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, … } from "@cesuain/ui";
// or the per-component entry point
import { Breadcrumb } from "@cesuain/ui/breadcrumb";
```

Exports: `Breadcrumb`, `BreadcrumbEllipsis`, `BreadcrumbItem`, `BreadcrumbLink`, `BreadcrumbList`, `BreadcrumbPage`, `BreadcrumbSeparator`.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `breadcrumb.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
